craft 7.0/10: It is tidy and pleasant with clean, consistent shapes, but it falls short of poster quality: the body and wing shapes are clumsy, the legs simply overlap the frame with no depth cues, and there is no ground, shadow or dynamism.
pelican 8.0/10: It is clearly a pelican with a beak, pouch, wing, legs and webbed feet, but it misses a 9-10 because the body is a lumpy, duck-like blob, the head is small, the upper bill is only a thin strip, the pouch looks like a separate bowl, and the legs are plain sticks.
[cli:claude] Make the pose dynamic: tilt the pelican forward over the bars, wrap the wingtip around the handlebar grip, and add speed lines or a ground shadow so it reads as riding, not posing.

bicycle.why: The bicycle is complete and mechanically believable, with a proper frame, spokes, hubs, chain, crank and pedals, but it misses a 10 because the stem and handlebar are one bare stroke, mostly hidden by the wing, and there is no rear cog.

riding.evidence: [No text in the artifact; this describes the image] The pelican's body rests on the saddle, each webbed foot sits on a pedal at opposite crank positions, and the wing reaches forward to the handlebar end
riding.why: It is seated, has its feet on the pedals and has a wing at the bars, but the upright, static pose (no forward lean, no motion lines) and the wing lying along the bar instead of gripping it keep it from a 10.
